text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our day off, Winning Ticket invites
me to
watch a race together.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Watching broadcasts in my room is great
too, but
there's something special about
the atmosphere
at a racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So let's watch an exciting race today and
get
really fired up!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
A hundred meters to go! And here
comes number
twelve from the outside!
She's closing in... she's
almost got them...
she takes the win!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! That was a great race! So
awesoooome!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: That Umamusume was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I heard her trainer is retiring, so I bet she
wanted
to send them off with a win.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
So that's why she was so intense...

Congratulations! You did great out
there!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wooow! She won the race for her
trainer! Isn't
that the most beautiful
thing?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Didja hear that just now, Trainer?! It's
gotta be
the sweetest thing ever!
Waaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh! For real!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look! The winner's crying... Nooo,
you'll make
me start bawling again!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I... wanna run... sniff... a race full of that much passion tooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of all her tears, Winning
Ticket finds
new resolution.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But contrary to her positive spirit, her
growth still
shows little progress...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm not even close to Taishin and
Hayahide's
times... Uuughhh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
They must be working even harder than I
thought!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer! Can I practice a little
longer
today again?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But at this rate, I'll be left behind! I
won't be able
to run an exciting race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's right. Narita Taishin and Biwa
Hayahide
have shown astonishing
progress recently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But forcing herself to train an unhealthy
amount
isn't going to help close that
gap. So there's only
one thing to do...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! I'm hitting the same problem
as
before the Derby—getting too
desperate for
results!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Can't rush! Need to focus! I need
STRONG
motivation!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll break my record tomorrow so I can
show
everyone an unforgettable race!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, that's it for today! Thanks,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no issue with Ticket's motivation,
nor with
the content of her practice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why we don't need to rush.
Sometimes it
takes time for hard work to
pay off, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although I do have to hope she'll start
gaining
ground soon...
